newsitem.title: USA: PSI in venture to market cameras in Asia.
newsitem.headline: PSI in venture to market cameras in Asia.

text.p: PSI Industries said on Friday it formed a joint venture agreement with Hong Kong-based Achiever Industries Ltd to market and distribute PSI's Message Camera in Asia.
Achiever already manufactures the message camera, as well as a line of 35mm, 110 and single-use cameras.
The message camera is a line of single-use cameras whcih feature pre-imprinted custom designs and messages on the film.
The two companies jointly created PSI Asia Ltd to market and distribute the Message Camera in Asia, PSI said.
PSI said the Message Camera was selling extremely well in the United States and should do as well or better in Asia.
